Web server integration.question: Which async web framework should we use for the REST and WebSocket APIs?
Web server integration.answer: (Recommended) aiohttp (Lightweight, plays very well with raw asyncio which paaf-session uses)
options_presented: (Recommended) aiohttp (Lightweight, plays very well with raw asyncio which paaf-session uses)
FastAPI / uvicorn (Standard, but might be overkill and heavier for an embedded appliance)

Web server integration.question: How should the web server run alongside the `paaf-session` turn loop?
Web server integration.answer: (Recommended) Run aiohttp's AppRunner inside an asyncio.Task in the same event loop (shares state easily)
options_presented: (Recommended) Run aiohttp's AppRunner inside an asyncio.Task in the same event loop (shares state easily)
Run aiohttp in a separate thread (harder to share asyncio state, requires thread-safe queues)

Web server integration.question: How should the WebSocket text chat channel (APP-03) interact with the voice loop?
Web server integration.answer: (Recommended) Text inputs are treated as synthetic voice barge-ins (interrupts current audio, resets state, processes text as next turn)
options_presented: (Recommended) Text inputs are treated as synthetic voice barge-ins (interrupts current audio, resets state, processes text as next turn)
Text inputs queue up and wait until the assistant is idle (does not interrupt speaking)

Web server integration.question: How should we enforce the LAN-only restriction for the API (APP-04)?
Web server integration.answer: Bind to 0.0.0.0 and assume the router firewall protects the LAN (no application-level checks)
options_presented: (Recommended) Reject requests whose `Origin` or `Host` header is not a private IP or `.local` (protects against DNS rebinding)
Bind to 0.0.0.0 and assume the router firewall protects the LAN (no application-level checks)
Bind strictly to the local network IP (e.g. 192.168.x.x) instead of 0.0.0.0
